title: Guatemala | World Coffee Guide
description: Guatemalan coffees tend to be sweet and chocolatey, with stone fruit and a proper acidity in the higher lots. Most of it is washed arabica grown on volcanic slopes, and each region has its own character, from the bright, dry-grown cups of Huehuetenango to the softer, spicier coffees of rainy Cobán.
seoDescription: Guatemala coffee guide: Antigua, Huehuetenango, Cobán, Anacafé regions, USDA production.
